the_three_rules_gate: Can I close my eyes and see a specific image? (Visualization)
Can I prove it true or false? (Empirical falsifiability)
Could a competitor NOT write this exact sentence? (Uniqueness & defensibility)
hard_rules: Zero em dashes (replace with commas, colons, or periods)
Zero contrast framing (BAN 'It's not X, it's Y' and 'Not only X, but also Y')
Zero forced symmetry or rule-of-three cliches (use 2 items or 4 items, never mechanical trios)
Zero copula avoidance (use 'is', 'are', 'has' instead of 'serves as', 'stands as', 'boasts', 'features')
Zero significance inflation (no 'pivotal moment', 'testament to', 'crucial role'; show the number instead)
One Action Rule (each asset drives exactly 1 clear outcome, CTAs state what the user gets)
